source_checklist.locator: Lee et al., Nature Methods 2019, DOI 10.1038/s41592-019-0547-z; PMC6765423 XML/PDF, Methods 'Bulk and single-cell m3C-seq library preparation' and read processing

pass_1.locations: PMC6765423 XML text lines 68, 146, 150; paper source bundle scraper run
pass_1.finding: The Methods explicitly inherit snmC-seq2 library generation from Luo et al. (2018); both reads lose 25 upstream and 3 downstream bases in processing. The paper does not identify the specific inherited random-primer or dual-index members used for each sn-m3C library. The own-bundle oligo scraper returned no oligo hits.

pass_2.finding: Independently confirmed that sn-m3C libraries are generated by Luo snmC-seq2 and both reads are trimmed 25 bp at the start and 3 bp at the end; the article does not select a specific random-primer or dual-index member.

source_checklist.locator: Lee et al. PMC6765423 supplementary files NIHMS1536531 supplements 1–8 and Springer MOESM1, in local MANIFEST.tsv

pass_1.locations: Local supplement manifest; extracted DOCX supplement 1 and DOC supplement 2; scraper across the local bundle
pass_1.finding: The accessible extracted supplements and scraper did not identify a sn-m3C primer-member assignment. Large workbook supplement 7 lacks a text twin and remains to be inspected; this first pass does not establish complete absence.

pass_2.locations: Local supplement-1 DOCX and supplement-2 DOC extracted text; supplement-7 XLSX converted to 37.9 MB text, sheet Table_S4 heading and primer/oligo/index search
pass_2.finding: The previously unconverted supplement-7 workbook is a differential-methylation-region data table, not an oligo table; no source-specific primer member assignment surfaced from this inspected supplement set.

pass_1.finding: Followed the explicitly inherited Luo snmC-seq2 method to its Supplementary Methods and indexed-primer table. Lee supplement 7 still needs inspection, and an independent second review is outstanding.

pass_2.locations: Lee PMC6765423 Methods line 146; Luo PMC6147798 and MOESM1, indexed workbook; Adaptase reagent reference
pass_2.finding: Followed snmC-seq2 link and inspected original oligo families; Adaptase vendor composition remains unexamined.

missing_claims.claim: Exact random-primer and index members used for each sn-m3C library are unreported.
missing_claims.evidence: Lee Methods delegates to a published 8-primer and indexed-PCR family but does not identify the member for each sample in the inspected text; supplementary workbook 7 has not yet been read.
Luo 2018 Supplementary Methods describes the commercial Adaptase step; complete reagent-derived bases require independent source review before this absence can be accepted.

conclusion: Independent second pass confirms source-published inherited random/P5/P7 oligo families and no sample-specific member assignment in inspected Lee supplements; commercial Adaptase composition remains blocked. No missing claim accepted.
